changes.summary: Preserve bounded Docker permission, daemon, timeout, and protocol failures before staging without attempting image rollback
Repair interdependent Review assessments, findings, and verdicts atomically while retaining unresolved blocking evidence
Render bounded colored TTY progress in place with semantic milestones and configurable live, log, color, and visibility policies
Provide shared editable multiline terminal input with cursor navigation, Unicode editing, validation retention, and deterministic pipe behavior
Reserve each bounded subprocess cleanup grace period for post-signal state transition, adoption, and reaping under slow host process observation
